items.name: JobSpy
items.description: Jobs scraper library for LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, ZipRecruiter, Bayt, Naukri, BDJobs & HelloWork

items.name: jobspy-api
items.description: Dockerized version of JobSpy job search utility with API key auth, rate limiting, and proxy support.

items.name: jobspy-mcp-server
items.description: MCP server to search for jobs across multiple job listing platforms

items.name: QuickApply
items.description: Local web service powered by JobSpy for job scraping, Codex for resume tuning, and unified application workflow.

items.name: ts-jobspy
items.description: TypeScript job scraper for LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, ZipRecruiter & more - rewritten from python-jobspy

items.name: Linkedin-Discord-Job-Scraper-Bot
items.description: This library is a Discord bot that automates job postings in Discord channels by scraping job listings from platforms like LinkedIn and Indeed using the JobSpy library, and manages these postings with a SQLite database

items.name: jobspy_scraper_api
items.description: API to scrap jobs from various web sites i.e; LinkedIn, Glassdoor, indeed, google, bayt, zip_recruiter and Naukri according to the parameters like hours old, country, city and so on via API endpoint. Connected with MongoDB as well for logging while maintaining pylint score 10/10.

items.name: iterbot
items.description: Bot de WhatsApp que conecta estudantes da UTFPR a vagas de estágio e emprego (vagas online via jobspy + vagas locais de empresas da região). Projeto de iniciação científica — Django, Celery, WAHA.

items.name: Applyfy
items.description: Self-hosted LinkedIn job digest: a FastAPI + JobSpy scraper API plus an n8n workflow that emails fresh job listings as an HTML table

items.name: jobspy-node
items.description: Node.js/TypeScript port of Jobspy. Provides a simple API to scrape job listings from various platforms
